pages.title: Grinding Unit
pages.text: The Grinding Unit grinds materials into ultra-fine powder — essential for batteries and advanced components.$(br2)Power: 50 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 per 2 seconds$(br)Clearance: 6x4
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
